clearly_in.why: Both complete pairs of helper classes record the same three events, forward to the same handlers, and throw after the same async wait. Queued wrapper names and the error string are the only substantive differences.

clearly_out.why: One span checks echoed header values; the other checks a CORS explanation string. Only the testing API's assertion syntax is shared.

One region declares DioException's fields (requestOptions, response, type, error, stackTrace) and the other RequestOptions' (followRedirects, maxRedirects, persistentConnection, requestEncoder, responseDecoder); every name, type and doc differs and only the Dart doc-comment-plus-field skeleton is shared — plainly not a copy.

Response's fields (requestOptions, statusCode, statusMessage, headers, isRedirect) share no member, type or doc with RequestOptions' fields (data, path, cancelToken, progress callbacks) — only the syntactic skeleton of documented field declarations.
